player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the task by issuing "DONE" after returning to the Closet, failing to explore the unvisited "south" direction available in that room. My strategy was flawed because I assumed the exploration was complete upon revisiting a room, rather than verifying that all available directions from the current location had been attempted. Next time, I will maintain a mental log of visited rooms and, crucially, ensure that every available direction from my current location is explored before declaring the task finished. Specifically, upon returning to the Closet, I will check the available directions again; if "south" is listed and has not been traversed yet, I will execute "GO: south" instead of "DONE". I will only output "DONE" when I am in a room where all adjacent directions lead to already visited rooms or no new directions are available.
